title: TerraRepair-Bench: A Judge-Free Harness and Dataset for LLM Repair of Terraform Security Misconfigurations
description: TerraRepair-Bench is a harness and dataset for measuring LLM repair of Terraform security misconfigurations. The released slice covers 262 modules from TerraDS v1 and ten foundation models, for 2,614 scored repairs. Each repair stores the raw model response, the exact repaired code that was scanned with pinned Trivy 0.74.0 and Checkov 3.3.20, before-and-after findings, and a SHA-256 hash tying the code to its score. No language model is in the scoring loop.
